response.sql: WITH equipment_averages AS (SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipment_reference, AVG(se.humepct) AS average_humidity FROM equipment AS e LEFT JOIN scanenvironment AS se ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry GROUP BY e.equipregistry), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS all_equipment_average FROM equipment_averages), above_average AS (SELECT ea.equipment_reference, ea.average_humidity, o.all_equipment_average FROM equipment_averages AS ea CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ea.average_humidity > o.all_equipment_average), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS above_group_average FROM above_average) SELECT a.equipment_reference, a.average_humidity, a.average_humidity - a.all_equipment_average AS exceeds_all_equipment_average, a.average_humidity - g.above_group_average AS difference_from_group_mean FROM above_average AS a CROSS JOIN group_average AS g WHERE a.all_equipment_average IS NOT NULL AND g.above_group_average IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean IS NULL, difference_from_group_mean DESC LIMIT 10;
